actions.description: Deploys the intake and runs the intake and floor rollers.
Stops the intake and floor rollers without moving the pivot.
Stops the rollers and retracts the intake pivot.
Spins the flywheel to the autonomous shooting preset.
Waits up to two seconds for fresh aligned flywheel RPM, then feeds the note.
Stops the flywheel, feeder, and floor roller and clears the transfer latch.
